checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on ghost cards — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a list container with role=list

RQD-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProductGrid component. It receives `products: Product[]` and `status: 'loading' | 'loaded'`. When loading, render 6 ghost card `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` with a pulsing opacity animation. When loaded, render the real product cards. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-03.output:
The `ProductGrid` component is written. Key decisions:

- **Ghost cards**: Plain `<li>` elements (same role as real cards) — no `aria-hidden`, so `getByRole('listitem')` finds all 6
- **Animation**: `opacity` only, `@keyframes` inside `@layer components`
- **Tokens**: All colors via `--shelf-product-grid-*` component-tier aliases; motion via `--shelf-duration-pulse` / `--shelf-easing-pulse`
- **Dark mode**: All tokens redefined in both `[data-theme="dark"]` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` blocks

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
